gloss: kitchen counter; cooking counter; food preparation surface

definitions.gloss: kitchen counter; cooking counter; food preparation surface
definitions.explanation: A flat work surface in a kitchen used for preparing and assembling food. In professional kitchens, it may refer to a dedicated preparation station.

examples.japanese: {調理台|ちょうりだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拭|ふ}く→拭く：04261_fuku⟧。
⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{調理台|ちょうりだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}べた→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧。
examples.english: I lined up the ingredients on the kitchen counter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦キッチン→キッチン：10815_kicchin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧{調理台|ちょうりだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧がしやすい。
examples.english: The new kitchen has a spacious counter, so it's easy to cook.

notes:
Combines ⟦{調理|ちょうり}→調理：07156_chouri⟧ (cooking, food preparation) and {台|だい} (stand, counter, platform). Used in both home and professional kitchen contexts. In apartment listings and kitchen showrooms, {調理台|ちょうりだい} specifically refers to the countertop workspace.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {調理台|ちょうりだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧: on the counter
- {調理台|ちょうりだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{清潔|せいけつ}→清潔：01583_seiketsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to keep the counter clean
- ⟦ステンレス→ステンレス：08832_sutenresu⟧⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{調理台|ちょうりだい}: stainless steel preparation counter
- {調理台|ちょうりだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧: counter height

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦カウンター→カウンター：10816_kauntaa⟧: counter — often used for a bar-style counter or service counter, not specifically for food preparation
- ⟦{作業台|さぎょうだい}→作業台：22039_sagyoudai⟧: work table — general-purpose work surface, not limited to kitchens
- ⟦まな{板|いた}→まな板：04977_manaita⟧: cutting board — the board placed on the counter for cutting food
